_comment: Phase 6 stubs - per-culture structures. Geometry borrowed (market_hall / housing_block / admin_office); furniture (pipeline_bench/planter/lamp_post) stays shared. Each has its own design file + identity.

pipeline_bench.name: Bench
pipeline_bench.description: A slatted public bench. Furniture: a low collision footprint, placed clear of every traffic lane.

pipeline_column.name: Support Column
pipeline_column.description: An octagonal structural column. The concourse is laid out around it, so it is allowed to stand on the centre-line.
